paraphrase: Umāpati refutes nine neighbouring views of soul, bonds and release — among them that the freed soul becomes equal to Śiva in every respect (Śivasamavāda), that the soul passes over into Śiva (Saṅkrāntavāda), that bonds remain like stone (Pāṣāṇavāda) — and upholds inseparable union in which the soul enjoys Śiva's bliss.
notes: Locator is a placeholder range for the whole work; the characterizations of the nine views are low confidence.
